verdict.rationale: Crossplane's evidence covers RBAC, drift correction, and composition/testing tooling, but there is no mention of a policy-as-code engine (e.g., OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno integration, admission-time validation, or CI policy gates) that blocks non-compliant infrastructure changes before apply. Community comments reference 'enforcement' generally (crossplane-comm-10) but do not describe a pre-apply policy check mechanism.
